2. The plaintiff petitioner instituted Title suit being ultimately numbered as Title Suit No.966 of 1985 in the court of Subordinate Judge, Gazipur praying for declaration that the plaintiff is the 16 annas owner of the suit land as described in the schedule to the plaint; that the document No. 5839 dated 15.10.1928 and document No.1385 dated 02.11.1931 is forged, fraudulent, void and not binding upon the plaintiff and that the RS and SA record were not correct and further prayed for recovery of khas possession of the suit land. 

 17. The case of the plaintiffs petitioners it appears from record that the petitioners filed an application for amendment of plaint on 28.02.1987 under order 6, Rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure to the effect that a suit being No. 133 of 1916 was instituted for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in respect of suit land which was finally decreed on compromise in terms of solenama filed by the plaintiffs and the defendant No. 1 Guljan Bibi. It is also the contention of the petitioners that the learned trial court fixed the date of hearing on 22.06.87 and the same application was again fixed on 24.06.87 for hearing and order. But the learned Subordinate Judge without disposing of that application for amendment illegally dismissed the case. It is the further contention of the petitioners that if the application for amendment was taken into the consideration the result of the suit would have been in their favour. 

 24. On perusal of the impugned judgment and order dated 13.04.1996. it appears that the learned Subordinate Judge frankly admitted that the plaintiff filed an application for amendment of plaint on 28.02.1987 under order 6 Rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure to the effect that a Suit being No. 133 of 1916 was instituted for declaration of title and recovery of Khas possession in respect of suit land which was finally decreed on compromise in terms of solenama filed by the plaintiff and the defendant No. 1 Guljan Bibi. But the said application for amendment was fixed for hearing on 22.06.1987 and the same was again fixed on 24.06.1987 for hearing and order. The learned Subordinate Judge admitted in the impugned judgment that no order was passed on 24.06.1987 on amendment application and the matter of amendment was not included in the plaint.
